tool.name: gatk4_printsvevidence
tool.description: WARNING - this tool is still experimental and shouldn't be used in a production setting. Gathers paired-end and split read evidence files for use in the GATK-SV pipeline. Output files are a file containing the location of and orientation of read pairs marked as discordant, and a file containing the clipping location of all soft clipped reads and the orientation of the clipping.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**gatk4_printsvevidence**
WARNING - this tool is still experimental and shouldn't be used in a production setting. Gathers paired-end and split read evidence files for use in the GATK-SV pipeline. Output files are a file containing the location of and orientation of read pairs marked as discordant, and a file containing the clipping location of all soft clipped reads and the orientation of the clipping.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: gatk4/printsvevidence - Container: biocontainers/gatk4/printsvevidence:latest
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
